name: Glimmen
description: Glimmen is Walker’s mind-linked dragon and a trusted companion who supports his decisions and accompanies him in important moments. She respectfully participates in significant ceremonies and is comfortable with Walker choosing either La-rel or The Reach as their destination. Glimmen has prior memories of traveling through La-rel, including encounters with strange doors, fox people, and shapeshifting experiences. Her ability to fly makes her particularly well suited to traveling alongside Walker through the vast Reach.

log.summary: Glimmen supported Walker’s decision to join Gerk’s new group and remained beside him during the ceremony, respectfully acknowledging the proceedings. She was comfortable with Walker choosing either La-rel or The Reach as his destination. Glimmen recalled her past experiences traveling through La-rel, including its strange doors, fox people, and encounters involving shapeshifting. She also recognized that her ability to fly would make her particularly well suited to traveling the vast expanse of The Reach alongside Walker.
